questions.prompt: Which of these are types of bean?
questions.fact: Baked beans in a tin are usually haricot beans, also called navy beans.

questions.prompt: Which of these are found inside a cell?
questions.fact: Mitochondria have DNA of their own, and you inherit it only from your mother.

questions.prompt: How many different first moves can White make in chess?
questions.fact: Twenty: each of the eight pawns can move one or two squares, and each knight has two choices.

questions.prompt: How tall is Michelangelo's statue of David, in metres?
questions.fact: 5.17 m, about three times the height of a real man.

questions.prompt: Which film has the line "I'll be back"?
questions.hint: It is said by a robot sent back in time.
questions.fact: Arnold Schwarzenegger wanted to say "I will be back", but the director made him keep the shorter line.

questions.prompt: Which Roman city was buried when Vesuvius erupted in AD 79?
questions.fact: The ash that buried Pompeii preserved bread in ovens and graffiti on the walls.
